transcript.content: Hi, welcome in—thanks for coming. What brings you in to see me today?
I got worked up in a staff meeting and started acting out this fall-prevention drill, using chairs and waving my arms around. I couldn’t seem to stop, even when people were telling me to sit down.
Besides that incident, have you noticed a stretch of days where you felt unusually energetic, elated, or irritable, needing much less sleep than usual?

Yeah. I’ll have stretches where I feel really bright and fired up, like everything is finally falling into place. But if somebody tries to slow me down or questions me, I can snap at them way harder than I mean to.
During these periods of feeling unusually energetic or irritable, have you been using alcohol, marijuana, stimulants, or any other substances?
I’m not really sure what you mean by substances. I haven’t noticed a connection like that.
When you have one of these bright, fired-up, high-energy stretches, about how many days in a row does it typically last?
I’m not sure, honestly. I haven’t really kept track of how many days they last in a row.
Have you ever gone through a separate stretch of at least two weeks where you felt persistently sad, low on energy, or lost interest in things you normally enjoy?
I’m not sure. I don’t really know if it’s lasted two weeks straight like that.
Have you ever had another period like this before—one where you felt extremely energetic, elated, or irritable for several days—prior to this recent episode?
Yeah. It’s been coming and going for about 11 months now—these times when I’m really energized, barely sleeping, and making big plans.
Over these past 11 months, have you been drinking alcohol, using marijuana, or taking any other drugs or medications around the times these energized, irritable episodes occur?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed a clear connection between that stuff and when those episodes happen.
Thinking about your most recent energized, irritable stretch—including the day of the staff meeting incident—about how many days in a row did that particular episode last?
It’s hard to pin down that one exactly. These stretches have been coming and going for about 11 months now.
Over the past 11 months, have you used alcohol, marijuana, or any other recreational drugs at all, even if you don't think it's related to these episodes?
I’m not sure, honestly. I haven’t really kept track of that over the past year.
Just to be clear, in the past 11 months, have you had any alcohol, marijuana, or other recreational drugs at all—even just once or twice?
I honestly can’t say for sure. I don’t remember well enough to tell you whether I used anything, even once or twice, during that time.
Can you tell me approximately when this current energized, irritable stretch started—like how many days before the staff meeting incident did you first notice feeling this way?
I’m not really sure how many days before. I can’t pin down when it started.
Have you ever used stimulant drugs like cocaine, methamphetamine, or amphetamine-based medications (prescribed or not) at any point during these energized periods?
I’m not sure. I can’t really say whether I used any of those during those times.
Focusing on your most recent energized, irritable stretch around the staff meeting—has it lasted at least a full week so far, even if you can't pin down the exact number of days?
Yeah, it’s been going on and off for about 11 months now—the energized times, barely sleeping, and making big plans.
Have you had any recent blood or urine tests—like a toxicology screen—done at work or in an ER, and if so, do you know what the results showed?
I don’t know. I can’t remember having any recent tests like that, or what the results would’ve been.
Has this energized, irritable stretch caused serious problems for you—like conflict at work, trouble with relationships, or needing hospitalization—beyond the staff meeting incident?

Yeah. I was put on leave from the senior center. At home, my wife’s had to remind me about chores and appointments because I’m not keeping up like I used to. I’ve also pulled back from my church friends, and I worry about whether it’s safe for me to go back to caregiving work.

Thinking back to right before the staff meeting incident—were you already feeling energized, needing less sleep, and full of big plans for at least a week before that day, or did it feel like it started more suddenly, just a few days before?
It wasn’t just a few days before. These periods of being really energized, hardly sleeping, and getting carried away with big plans have been coming and going for about 11 months.
